relevance.reason: The African Union's continental policy framework for AI, endorsed by the Executive Council in July 2024. It sets a common vision, five focus areas and fifteen action areas for AI development and governance in Africa. It is a strategy, not a treaty.
ai_provisions: Whole strategy — AI benefits, capabilities, risk mitigation, investment and cooperation
relevance.excluded_scope: Non-binding continental strategy; implementation depends on AU Member States and regional bodies.

dates.notes: Endorsed by the AU Executive Council at its 45th Ordinary Session in Accra, Ghana, on 18–19 July 2024; document page dated 9 August 2024.

status_note: Endorsed by the Executive Council. Non-binding; implementation phase proposed for 2025–2030.

languages.note: AU page links English, French, Arabic and Portuguese versions; English was consulted and is recorded as the acquired language, not as a verified sole authentic text.
